hooks.command: bash -c '. "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/fleet-emit.sh" 2>/dev/null && oracle_emit "Zeus" "oracle:session_start" "Session started" "info" "zeus-oracle" && echo "📡 Fleet: session broadcast enabled"'

bash -c 'skill=$(cat | grep -oE "\"skill\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"[^\"]*\"" | sed -E "s/.*:[[:space:]]*\"([^\"]*)\"/\1/"); if [[ "$skill" =~ ^(fleet-awaken|awaken)$ ]] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/fleet-registry/oracles.json" ]; then echo "✓ Fleet registry active"; fi'
